title: Shortest Paths
description: Dijkstra's idea: settle the nearest unsettled place, then see whether it gives a shorter way to its neighbours. Unlocks routed Photonic Processors.

puzzle.goal: Dijkstra settles V junctions over L links, keeping the nearest unsettled one in a heap that takes log₂ V steps per change. Write the work T.
puzzle.name: Running time
puzzle.ask: Find T for V = @{V} and L = @{L}.
puzzle.method: Every junction is taken out of the heap once and every link may shorten a distance once; each costs log₂ V.
